5._section_summary: This section introduces the affect regulation model of positive body image, discussing concepts like body image flexibility and body appreciation. The present study, referred to as 'the current preliminary investigation', aims to extend this model by examining body image flexibility as a mediator between body dissatisfaction and body appreciation. The study focuses on a pre-college sample of White older adolescent females, and a secondary aim is to operationalize body dissatisfaction using broader body size comparison referents.

6.evidence_source: The section is titled '4. Discussion', which is a standard section in a journal article.
6._section_summary: This discussion section interprets the findings of the present study, which investigated whether body image flexibility mediated the associations between body size discrepancies and body appreciation in a pre-college sample of White older adolescent females. The results confirmed that compassionately and mindfully confronting body-related thoughts partially explains the inverse relationship between body dissatisfaction and body appreciation, even when controlling for BMI. The section also outlines several limitations of this single study, including its small, racially-homogenous, non-random, cross-sectional sample, low response rate, and reliance on self-report measures, while suggesting future research directions.
